title: Commercial Insights Analyst
text: Commercial Insights Analyst at Jemena (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Global Healthy Workplace Award Winner Located in Melbourne CBD or North Sydney 12 month fixed term contract About us Jemena owns and operates significant gas, electricity and water transportation assets across Australia’s east coast, supplying millions of households and businesses with essential services every day. With more than a century’s experience and expertise in the utilities sector and our strong portfolio of important distribution and transmission assets, we are ready to make the most of opportunities for growth and innovation. As a provider of gas, electricity and water, we have enduring relationships with our customers and the communities where we operate. They are at the heart of our commitment to deliver energy and water safely, reliably and affordably, and to the sustainable growth of our business in the long term. About the opportunity Reporting to the Commercial Insights and Analytics Manager, we have an opportunity available for a Commercial Insights Analyst to join us for a 12 month fixed term contract based in either North Sydney or Melbourne CBD. This role is required to provide support and data-driven insights for business planning, market and product strategy development, regulatory compliance and business case development via the provision of highly sophisticated market and commercial analysis and economic modelling. What we’re looking for The successful candidate will be tertiary qualified and come with solid experience and/or a good understanding of the utilities/energy industry while also being able to demonstrate strong stakeholder engagement skills to understand business priorities and problems and provide solutions in a collaborative manner. Other qualifications, skills and experience required include; • Previous experience within an analytics role (or similar) within a large company is essential, • Strong quantitative experience around interrogating large datasets with advanced proficiency in spreadsheet and database programs, such as Microsoft Excel, • Using predefined business metrics as well as proposing new metrics, develop performance reporting to allow for lag and lead indicators to be measured, • Undertake and support profitability, customer, demand and revenue modelling, analysis and forecasting, • Ability to develop insights from market and customer information. • Must possess the ability to influence internally, externally, and be able to drive decisions across an organisation, • Must thrive in a fluid, fast-paced evolving environment, • Capacity to work under competitive pressure and meet tight deadlines, With a proven ability to think strategically, thorough and logically, this role requires someone with strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to write clearly and concisely to produce professional reports. To apply: please submit a cover letter and CV Jemena is not accepting submissions from recruitment agencies for this role. Jemena is a dynamic company that focuses on attracting and motivating talented industry professionals. We’ve made it our priority to create an exceptional workplace with competitive salaries, educational assistance and salary packaging options, among other benefits.
